summary: The agent successfully implements a cross-validated ensemble of CatBoost and LightGBM with adequate feature engineering. However, it introduces data leakage by computing imputation statistics and frequency encodings on the combined train/test dataset. It also uses naive ensembling and ignores potential temporal ordering in the data during cross-validation.
